You can skip an ad. You can't skip being thirsty.

A screen gets a glance. A free bottle of water gets picked up, carried and put on the desk next to you. It's the one ad they say thank you for. Brands pay, partners make and distribute the bottles, and people drink for free.

Three steps.
No media kit.

1

Pick your panels

Choose single panels or a whole side. Sizes are shown as you go, so your designer knows exactly what to make.

2

Drop in your artwork

Upload a JPG, PNG or WEBP, rotate it if you need to, and turn the bottle to see it from every side.

3

Send it to us

We receive your artwork and a four-sided render of your bottle, review it, and get back to you.

Put it on the bottle.

Tick the panels you want, then upload artwork to each one. Take all 7 panels for sale, or share the bottle with non-competing brands. The lower back holds Free2Drink company information.
